$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editor autocompletion. Ignored by Portweave at runtime.

projectName.description: Optional human-friendly project label shown in the portweave panel dashboard. Falls back to a name derived from the git repository when unset.

envAuthority.description: Who wins when the project .env names a key Portweave also computes. "dotenv" (default): an explicit .env entry pins the value. "portweave": the computed value wins and .env is not read at all — for projects whose .env is shared or symlinked across worktrees and so cannot carry a per-worktree port. The parent process environment beats both either way.

pool.description: Allocate from a fixed set of slots instead of scanning a machine-wide pool. Slot i spans [basePort + i*stride, basePort + i*stride + serviceCount - 1], which makes the full set of possible ports enumerable (see `portweave slots`) — necessary when an external service must pre-register every candidate URL, as OAuth redirect allow-lists cannot wildcard a port. Omit for the default first-fit behaviour.

mode.description: Only "slots" is supported. Omitting the pool block entirely selects first-fit allocation over PORTWEAVE_POOL_RANGE.

stride.description: Distance between consecutive slot base ports. Must be >= the number of services so adjacent slots do not overlap.

slots.description: How many slots exist. Allocation fails once every slot is taken rather than drifting outside the set.

primarySlot.description: Slot pinned to the primary (non-linked) worktree. It always receives this slot; if those ports are occupied the allocation fails (PW0402) rather than moving, so anything pre-registered against them keeps working.

services.description: Map of kebab-case service name to its port/env configuration. At least one entry is required.

envVar.description: Environment variable name the allocated port is exposed as. Must be unique across all services.

group.description: Group label. Services that share a group are allocated as a contiguous block so they move together.

preferred.description: DEPRECATED and ignored; removed in 0.9. Never read by the allocator. Use the top-level "pool" block with "mode": "slots" for a deterministic, enumerable port set.

discoveryEnv.description: Additional environment variables mapped to derived values. Templates use ${serviceName} to interpolate that service's allocated port, ${pw:namespace}/${pw:worktreeRoot}/${pw:gitCommonDir} for worktree metadata, and the reserved ${namespace} token (shorthand for ${pw:namespace}) for the worktree namespace. Keys must not start with the reserved PORTWEAVE_ prefix.
